mainEntity.name: Do I really need a professional website for my business?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional website helps build trust, improves online visibility, and makes it easier for customers to learn about your services and contact your business. It also supports long-term business growth.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build a custom website?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typical business websites take 4–6 weeks, while complex e-commerce or custom web applications may take 8–12 weeks depending on requirements.

mainEntity.name: Why is my website not getting traffic from Google?

acceptedAnswer.text: Poor website structure, slow speed, weak content, and technical SEO issues can affect rankings. Proper SEO optimization improves visibility and traffic.
An SEO-friendly website includes fast loading speed, mobile responsiveness, optimized content, proper structure, and strong technical SEO setup.

mainEntity.name: Which is better for my business: SEO or Google Ads?

acceptedAnswer.text: SEO builds long-term organic traffic, while Google Ads gives immediate results. Most businesses use both for better performance and lead generation.

mainEntity.name: How can social media marketing help my business grow?

acceptedAnswer.text: Social media marketing increases brand awareness, engagement, and leads by targeting customers on platforms like Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn.

mainEntity.name: What does a software development company actually do?
